identityScope: Four existing catalog rows in the cleaning category that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Xiaomi overview and specification pages. Robot Vacuum X20+, S40, S40 Pro and S40C are four separate models with their own pages. No new model was created and no Xiaomi company focus review exists. The X20+ page publishes 6,000 Pa suction, 180 rpm rotational mopping with automatic mop lifting, an S-Cross wide-area structured-light obstacle avoidance system, LDS navigation, 10-second automatic dust collection, automatic mop washing, air drying, 140 minutes of vacuuming and mopping in Standard mode, a 5200 mAh nominal battery, 3.67 kg, a 350 x 350 x 97 mm body, a 4 L clean water tank covering up to 280 m2 per fill, a 75-day dust bag and a 586 x 427 x 340 mm station. The S40 (OV81) page publishes 10,000 Pa, multidimensional hair anti-tangle technology, integrated vacuuming and mopping with three water-flow levels, LDS navigation, 180 minutes of vacuuming and mopping, 4.12 kg, a 340 x 340 x 98 mm body, a 5200 mAh nominal battery, a 520 mL dust box with a 270 mL water tank and a 130 x 121 x 95 mm charging dock. The S40 Pro (OV71GL) page publishes 15,000 Pa, dual extended mechanical arms reaching 0 mm at corners and 1 mm along walls, a 129-degree ultra-wide-angle structured light system, 360-degree scanning, a 180 m2 cleaning area per charge, 4.2 kg, a 355 x 350 x 99 mm body, a 5200 mAh nominal battery, a 430 mL dust box with a 310 mL water tank and a 146 x 122 x 98.5 mm charging dock. The S40C (E101) page publishes 5,000 Pa, LDS navigation with multiple sensors, three water-flow levels, 3.44 kg, a 340 x 340 x 97 mm body, a 2600 mAh nominal battery, a 520 mL dustbin with a 260 mL water tank and a 130 x 121 x 95 mm charging dock. No reviewed page publishes a price, so all four catalog prices are cleared; the catalog S40 battery label of 180 min is replaced by the nominal capacity, and the S40 Pro and S40C run times stay unrecorded because the pages publish an area per charge but no minutes.

fields.description: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20+ is a robot vacuum and mop with 6,000 Pa fan-blower suction, high-speed rotational mopping at 180 rpm with automatic mop lifting, an S-Cross wide-area structured-light obstacle avoidance system and LDS laser navigation, and an all-in-one station with 10-second automatic dust collection, automatic mop-pad washing, air drying and a 4 L clean water tank. It measures 350 x 350 x 97 mm and weighs 3.67 kg, carries a 5200 mAh nominal battery for up to 140 minutes of vacuuming and mopping in Standard mode, covers up to 280 m2 per tank fill, and uses a 75-day dust bag. The station measures 586 x 427 x 340 mm. The pages publish no price, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or minimum aisle width; the catalog ~400 USD price is cleared.

highlights: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20+ delivers 6,000 Pa fan-blower suction with high-speed rotational mopping at 180 rpm and automatic mop lifting.
An S-Cross wide-area structured-light obstacle avoidance system and LDS laser navigation plan routes and avoid obstacles.
The all-in-one station empties dust in 10 seconds, washes the mop pads automatically and holds a 4 L clean water tank rated for up to 75 days of dust storage.
A 5200 mAh nominal battery supports up to 140 minutes of vacuuming and mopping in Standard mode, and one tank fill covers up to 280 m2.
The robot measures 350 x 350 x 97 mm and weighs 3.67 kg; the pages publish no price or charging time, so the catalog ~400 USD price is cleared.
